name: animate trees
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option.
An animated tree acts as an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.
